text: dsh-ohjingjing-team（DSH 插件，Web 客户端）：用动画鲸鱼装饰智能体团队界面。它通过宿主侧资源路由提供精灵图，并在浏览器端按启用状态挂载组件。主要功能包括替换团队成员状态图标、在会话标题栏展示主会话与子代理跑道，以及替换子代理下拉列表的状态点；三块组件可分别开关。适合希望个性化 DSH 团队面板和会话页头的用户。需要 DSH Web 客户端及宿主 webServer，成员行皮肤还需要官方智能体团队组件。

dsh-ohjingjing-team decorates DSH Web team panels with animated whales. It replaces member and subagent status icons and adds a runway for the lead session and recent subagents. Components toggle separately. Requires the DSH Web host and webServer.
想把 DSH 智能体团队成员的状态图标换成可爱的动画形象。
能不能在会话标题栏给主会话和子代理加一条动态跑道？
我想让子代理下拉列表里的状态圆点显示成鲸鱼图标。
如何分别启用或关闭 DSH 团队面板里的装饰组件？
给 DSH 的团队面板换个主题，同时保留不同成员的运行状态。
让正在工作的子代理在会话页头跑动，停下来时保持原地。
Can I replace the status icons in the DSH agent team panel with animated art?
I want a session header track that shows the lead agent and recent subagents running.
dsh-ohjingjing-team 的功能「成员状态皮肤」：把智能体团队面板成员行的状态图标替换为鲸鱼精灵图。浏览器端注入皮肤样式，并由组件开关控制是否启用。
dsh-ohjingjing-team 的功能「会话标题栏跑道」：在会话标签行右侧显示主会话和最新子代理的动画鲸鱼。鲸鱼按运行状态移动或停留，并可随组件开关卸载。
dsh-ohjingjing-team 的功能「子代理列表图标」：将子代理下拉列表各行的状态圆点替换为鲸鱼图标。浏览器端注入独立样式表，可单独关闭。
dsh-ohjingjing-team 使用前须知：需要 DSH Web 宿主提供 webServer 来注册素材路由；成员行皮肤还要求官方智能体团队组件启用。（见 lib/index.js:38-40、README.md:87-91）

dsh-ohjingjing-team README · 依赖：| 项 | 值 |
|---|---|
| DSH | `≥0.2.1-rc.5` |
| 官方智能体团队组件<sub>@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile</sub> | 仅组件1需要，保持开启 |

dsh-ohjingjing-team README · 🎛 可调参数：| 变量 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `--oj-max-size` | `40px` | **皮肤**尺寸上限，防止在极端字号下图标失控。 |
| `--oj-runner-size` | `26px` | **跑道**里鲸鲸的边长（26px 时脚正好压在那条分隔线上）。 |
| `--oj-runners-gap` | `26px` | **跑道**初次出现时相邻两只的槽位间距（满员时按轨道长度自动收窄）。 |
| `--oj-lap-duration` | `60.2s` | **跑道**一圈的时长（60.2s = 86 个走帧循环，步点与走帧同相位；改大改小会按比例改变地面速度）。 |
| `--oj-max-subagents` | `20` | **跑道**最多画多少个**子代理**（lead 之外；DSH 会把历史子代理留在总数里，所以取最新的这些）。 |
| `--oj-catalog-size` | `26px` | **子代理列表**里图标位的边长（官方只有 14×17；放大后行内文字右移 12px，行高不变）。 |
| `--oj-duration` | `0.7s` | **走帧一圈**的时长，步数多的动画自动按比例拉长（三块组件共用）。 |

dsh-ohjingjing-team README · 📜 版本：- **0.4.2** —— 修复 DSH 0.2.2 起**标题栏跑道整条不出现**：官方把 `[data-conversation-tabs]` 从整行移到行内一个按内容收缩的标签列表上，跑道仍按该元素量自由宽度（结果恒为 0）；现在按标签行量，并从行内最右内容（含「更多视图」按钮）之后起跑。
- **0.4.1** —— 跑道改成**一条共用轨道**：lead 永远在、跟着最新的 20 个子代理，跑完一圈回起点重生（无 offset）、停下就地站住、按剧本周期性切换动作；新增**子代理列表**组件（下拉行的圆点换成鲸鲸）；`--oj-cruise-scale` 与 `--oj-min-segment` 被 `--oj-lap-duration` 取代。
- **0.4.0** —— 新增**标题栏跑道**组件：会话头部标签行右侧画上子代理，动作与成员行同位次同玩法、位移与动画同步折返；两块组件可分别开关。
- **0.3.0** —— 运行中从「一套七帧跑动」变成**四种**动画。
- **0.2.2** —— 修复帧边缘的**邻帧残留**。
- **0.2.1** —— 修复跑动动画**少播一帧**：关键帧的时间刻度与位置刻度被写成同一套，导致最后一帧的时间区间长度为零。
- **0.2.0** —— 失败态换成**倒立**姿态；运行态从两帧往返改为**七帧循环**。
- **0.1.2** —— 修复失败态素材被裁。
- **0.1.1** —— 修复高 DPI 屏图标发糊，并修复 `error` 状态回落为 `idle`；图标边长默认 28px → 31px（用满两行文字高度，成员卡仍为 51px）。
- **0.1.0** —— 首个版本。

Refresh the Web GUI and open the Team panel once. The header runway appears on its own in the session header; no extra switch is needed.

**One row per switch in the plugin manager**, all on by default, each switchable on its own; every row shows its own name and one-line description:

dsh-ohjingjing-team README · Web / desktop plugin manager：| Component | Entry name | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| Agent Team skin | `dsh-ohjingjing-team/skin` | member-row icons become ohjingjing |
| Header runway | `dsh-ohjingjing-team/runners` | the runway to the right of the header tab row |
| Subagent list | `dsh-ohjingjing-team/catalog` | the dots in the "N subagents" dropdown rows |
| The package itself | `dsh-ohjingjing-team` | the stylesheets and the runway runtime shared by the three |

dsh-ohjingjing-team README · Dependencies：| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| DSH | `≥0.2.1-rc.5` |
| Official Agent Team component<sub>@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile</sub> | needed by component 1 only; keep it enabled |
dsh-ohjingjing-team README · 🎛 Tunables：Appearance lives in custom properties on `:root`; overriding them needs no rebuild (user styles or browser overrides work):

dsh-ohjingjing-team README · 🎛 Tunables：| Variable | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--oj-max-size` | `40px` | **Skin** size bound, so the icon cannot run away at extreme font sizes. |
| `--oj-runner-size` | `26px` | **Runway** whale edge (at 26px the feet rest on that separator line). |
| `--oj-runners-gap` | `26px` | **Runway** slot spacing on first appearance (a full roster narrows it to fit the track). |
| `--oj-lap-duration` | `60.2s` | **Runway** duration of one lap (60.2s = 86 walk cycles, so footfalls stay in phase with the sprite; a longer or shorter lap scales the ground speed). |
| `--oj-max-subagents` | `20` | How many **subagents** the runway draws at most, beyond the lead (DSH keeps finished subagents in its totals, so the newest ones win). |
| `--oj-catalog-size` | `26px` | **Subagent list** icon-slot edge (the official slot is 14×17; enlarging it shifts the row text 12px right without changing row height). |
| `--oj-duration` | `0.7s` | **One walk cycle**, shared by the three components; animations with more steps scale up automatically. |

dsh-ohjingjing-team README · 📜 Versions：- **0.4.2** — fixes the **header runway disappearing entirely** on DSH 0.2.2+: the official mark `[data-conversation-tabs]` moved from the full-width row onto a content-sized tab list inside it, while the runway still measured free width on that element (always 0); it now measures the row and starts after the rightmost content in it, including the "more views" button.
- **0.4.1** — the runway became **one shared track**: the lead is always on it, followed by the newest 20 subagents; a finished lap respawns at the start with no offset, stopping happens in place, and a script cycles through the actions; a new **subagent list** component swaps the dropdown dots for whales; `--oj-cruise-scale` and `--oj-min-segment` were replaced by `--oj-lap-duration`.
- **0.4.0** — adds the **header runway** component: subagents are drawn to the right of the session header's tab row, each with the same mode as its member-row position and with displacement reversing together with the turn; the two components are switchable separately.
- **0.3.0** — running went from one seven-frame run to **four** animations.
